functions.residue: RESIDUE LOOP-SHAPE 218 2 branch target(s) differ, first at 0x68
functions.description: Combat window buffer setup with margins
functions.notes: Size now equals slot (0x248). Remaining: (1) prologue stack-arg load order (target loads ptr and h before the field stores; mine interleaves); (2) margin block sx/sy land in ip/r2 instead of r4/sl so the call args are not stm {r4,sl} (one extra str, block 1 is 4 bytes longer than target); (3) second block loads fA8 before fAA where target loads fAA first. Best form: sx/sy as short, ox/oy as int zero-initialised separately (oy = 0, oy += margins[0]), sx/sy updated in place and passed to func_0204f914. Colorsweep applied twice, no further gain after ~26 gate runs.
